reviews.author: Payton Oles
reviews.text: I had a great experience here and will definitely be coming back. They replaced my harmonic balancer, serpentine belt, and knock sensor on my 2016 Camaro, and the difference is night and day. My car drives smoother, the wobble is completely gone, and the check engine light is finally off. What really impressed me was that they didn’t just throw parts at it, they took the time to troubleshoot the issue, cleaned the grounds, and made sure everything was done right. They’re honest, knowledgeable, and their labor rates are very fair. It’s hard to find a mechanic you can trust, but these guys have definitely earned my business. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Tricia Selby
reviews.text: Thank you, Coastal Car Fix! My son was told by another mechanic that his car needed a new starter. Before moving forward with the repair, he decided to get a second opinion from Coastal Car Fix. Dan and his team thoroughly checked the car and honestly told us that all it needed was a new battery. They were absolutely right, and his car has been running perfectly ever since! We truly appreciate their honesty, professionalism, and integrity. It's refreshing to find a repair shop you can trust. Thank you, Dan and the entire Coastal Car Fix team, we're so grateful and highly recommend you!

reviews.author: John Paysour
reviews.text: Long story short, the shop that changed our oil before heading to the beach didn't properly install the oil plug, which worked it's way loose and dumped the oil on our way to dinner Saturday evening. (Fortunately, we were able to shut her down before any engine damage was done.) I found Coastal Car Fix online, messaged them, and got a call Sunday morning from the owner. AAA towed it there and they were all over it the first thing Monday morning. They took the time to clean underneath the engine and trans, as well as the under-plate. Very professional staff. Thank you Dan, Joe, and team!

reviews.author: JESSICA ROSS
reviews.text: I came in for a service appointment and had a really great experience from start to finish. The service was completed quickly, and everything about the process felt easy and convenient. They were very transparent about what was needed and took the time to explain things clearly without any pressure to add on extra services. The shuttle service was a huge plus and made the whole visit even more stress-free. Most importantly, I felt completely comfortable and respected as a woman, which isn’t always the case at car shops. That meant a lot. Overall, efficient, honest, and professional, I’ll definitely be back.

reviews.author: Karen Baylor
reviews.text: We are out of state and our vehicle started making noise. I pulled up auto mechanics near us and several came up. I picked coastal car fix and called them that next morning. I was told they had an open at 11am. I got there at 11 they took my vehicle back at 1130. By 1245 they had showed us what was wrong and had it fixed. Chip and Joe was extremely professional and nice. They place was clean and the bathroom. U also could get some pet therapy from Ozzy. Thank you again for everything. Karen

reviews.author: Jessica Michelle
reviews.text: Absolutely great experience. On vacation 600 miles away from home and had water pump issues. Called looking for a quote and I was given options and information. The owners took multiple calls and applied no pressure for my business. Quick service, friendly and reasonable price. Would recommend to anyone and if we are in need again definitely going back.

reviews.author: Donna Bogan
reviews.text: Coastal Car Fix did an excellent job with fixing the audio issues I was having with my Subaru. I was able to get a fast appointment. I dropped my car off in the morning, was given a ride back home and was picked up when my car was ready that same afternoon. I would highly recommend for all your auto needs. The waiting area was very clean and fresh. The employees courteous. They have been added to my address book for future needs.

reviews.author: Rachael Ross
reviews.text: The most convenient and incredible service! At another shop, my mother is law got quoted a ridiculous amount for a simple tune up. We got another opinion from Coastal Car Fix, who explained exactly what was needed without the frills. They are the best!!!!!

reviews.author: Richard
reviews.text: Having recently moved to the area, started experiencing issues with our 2022 Lexus. Came across Coastal Car Fix and was able to get it in first thing the following day. Within hours car was diagnosed and quote for repairs was given. Even with getting a part brought in was able to pick up the car early afternoon same day. Dan and crew are great. Shop is the cleanest auto repair shop I’ve ever seen. Definitely have found a long term mechanic to service our vehicles

reviews.author: Jason smith
reviews.text: They seemed very honest and explained the issue going on with my car in depth to me. They actually suggested I not do the service to the age of my car and the involve cost. They seem to be very honest and are Not trying to get you and do services that are not needed. Would recommend!

reviews.author: Jeremy Gile
reviews.text: Outstanding Service and Communication! I brought my 2002 Toyota 4-Runner to Coastal Car Fix when it suddenly wasn’t running well. They were able to get me in the same day I called. Their app is easy to use and keeps you updated every step of the way with real-time status updates, estimates, and notes on the work being done. Communication with the shop was excellent. Before doing any repairs, they walked me through the options, explained everything clearly, and made sure I was comfortable with the plan. They quickly diagnosed the issue as a faulty oxygen sensor, which turned out to be the most affordable fix among the possibilities I had in mind. They had my 4-Runner running perfectly again in just a couple of hours. Great customer experience from start to finish. Highly recommend Coastal Car Fix.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Todd
reviews.text: Fantastic experience at Coastal Car Fix. I brought my truck in for some services that I did not have the time to do at home, and these guys got me in and out the same day at a much more reasonable cost than I was receiving in Florida. Chip and Dan are true gentlemen, and made sure I had a ride to and from the shop which was a HUGE courtesy in my situation of staying at a campground nearby. I HIGHLY recommend this shop and would rate it a 10 if I could. The trust they established with me is priceless.

reviews.author: Billy Dixon
reviews.text: The team at Coastal Car Fix were fantastic. Called them, explained my situation, had an appointment the next day and within a couple hours they had my truck fixed and actually found another small issue I hadn’t known about and fixed it too. Couldn’t have been more impressed. Great work, fair prices. I will definitely be using them for all my vehicle repairs in the future. Great job!

reviews.author: Gladstone Adams III
reviews.text: This was my first time at this shop. They were very responsive when I called about my issue with the car and got me in the very next day. Everyone was extremely courteous and seemed eager to be of assistance. They also seemed very knowledgable as mechanics. The job was done in a day and a half, even when one part had to overnighted to complete the job. The icing on the cake was the offer of a shuttle service as I had just moved from out of town and was without a car while they repaired it.

reviews.author: JR Piosek
reviews.text: This is the first time I’ve written about an automotive maintenance and repair experience ever, likely because they were mediocre at best and many times worrisome. Dan and Chip restored my trust in humanity as it relates to automotive repair. I don’t say this lightly. I had a pretty good idea of what needed to be done as I am no young person and have had many car experiences as we all have or will have. It’s stressful when cars breaks, and they always do. These guys have integrity and not on the way politicians use the word “integrity”. Chip picked me up and drove me around. I thought he was the shuttle dude and turns out, nope, invested in it and cares. Price was what I expected and no up-sale tactics. Just legit stand up guys doing quality work. I would take my vehicles back again and again with no hesitation. Thank you Dan, Chip and team!

reviews.author: Sheri P
reviews.text: Buyer beware. I paid $70 for a diagnosis and $89 for an oil change. The oil filter has been leaking since I brought it home. Dan said I needed a new transmission and quoted almost $4k to replace. I'm at a transmission shop now. It does NOT need a new transmission. Don't waste your money ! It needed a drive belt repair and the a/c compressor is going bad. I had the repair done and was told to wait until the a/c stopped working to replace. the oil drip was taken care of. Everyone I told about my experience said you were cheating me bc I was an "old woman". I hope that isn't the case and you are just not good at diagnosing problems.

reviews.author: Andy Nguyen
reviews.text: Messaged Daniel about my control arm issue and he had me taken care of quickly. They ordered an upgraded set from lethal performance and knocked out the job in no time. Super clean lobby and shop also!

reviews.author: Steven Heiner
reviews.text: This was my first time using this service. I was able to get a quick appointment, and they even dropped me off and picked me up when the job was completed. The shop is immaculate. I've been in doctor's offices that weren't this clean! Hopefully my issue was resolved. Chip and Dan couldn't have been nicer. Top notch service. Edit 02/25/26 I still agree with my previous review, however my next service was not as positive. I paid $1,100 to repair a fueling problem with my truck, and the issue was not resolved. When I contacted them, they responded but offered no remedy other than fueling more carefully. Spending that much without repairing the issue is very disappointing. Perhaps a bit more research on their part may have been helpful.

reviews.author: Russ Armstrong
reviews.text: Can’t say enough great things about Coastal Car Fix!! Went in for an AC problem. Wasn’t blowing cold. They got me in and out same day! Extremely professional and thorough with their diagnosis! Left with AC blowing cold as it’s ever been! Will most definitely be returning!!

reviews.author: Nancy Pion
reviews.text: I just called them and explained the problem I was having with my Mercedes CLA250. I told them the messages my car was giving out. I heard they worked on Mercedes and that is why I called. The gentleman said they don’t do that repair. We found a garage in Pawley’s Island and it was the sensors that went bad. I’m guessing Coastal was too busy and it was real hot. I gave them a 4 for telling me where I could take it. I really wanted someone local. The last picture was showing how hot that day was.

reviews.author: Donna Campbell
reviews.text: Excellent service, very respectful and reasonable. They take you home and pick you up when your vehicle is ready. They explained was what's wrong with my car. I love the fact that I can use an app and borrow money to fix my car and pay in installments. GREAT place highly recommend to anyone!

reviews.author: Doug Jennings
reviews.text: Friendly people, awesome service and very efficient. I could go on and on, but come see for yourselves. I highly recommend everyone check out Coastal Car Fix. I have a list of repairs and Dan and staff will be taking care everything for me.

reviews.author: Donna Lovallo
reviews.text: We are so happy to have found Coastal Car Fix. My Audi had AC problems and they took me right away and went extra mile to get the parts needed. They now have two new customers. My husband has an Audi also. Thanks to everyone who made our experience a good one.

reviews.author: John Puglia
reviews.text: I was a pleasure dealing with Coastal Car Fix. They were very professional and quickly diagnosed my cars problem. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Mark
reviews.text: Dan was extremely transparent with what the issue I was having was, and on what the repair was. They drove me home while they were working on it, drove me back to pick it up, and it got the repair done same day!! Definitely going here for all my repairs and maintenance from now on.

reviews.author: Jennifer Gaddy
reviews.text: These guys are Wonderful in every way! They are very knowledgeable, accurate, and very reasonable priced. I wouldn’t take my car anywhere else!!!

reviews.author: Dawn Lanahan
reviews.text: EDIT: 6/24/26 I had to bring my car back for more repairs. Once again Coastal Car Fix was consistent with their service and communication. Having almost $250k miles on my car she's going to need more things taken care of. I'm actually looking forward to having the work done knowing that I have a company I can trust and rely on. Everyone was super helpful. Explained what was going on. Pricing was fair, they actually went above and beyond for me. I also appreciated the fact that texting was an option. Working retail, I can't always answer the phone. Definitely going back to Coastal Car Fix for all of my repairs. Thankful to have found them.

reviews.author: Matthew Kosienski
reviews.text: Took my car to Myrtle Beach Hyundai. It is a Genesis. They quoted me a price of over $7000 to repair it. I got a second opinion and went with Dan at coastal car fix and they did a remarkable job for a fraction of the price will definitely use him and recommend him to anyone that asked me. They’re clear, concise and professional.

reviews.author: Melissa Hoevker
reviews.text: I am extremely satisfied with my experience. They got my vehicle in right away and was fixed the next day. And was very affordable

reviews.author: Adrianna Derrick
reviews.text: Coastal Car Fix is the best! Dan was super helpful and explained everything clearly. They even gave me a free shuttle ride home while my car was being fixed, which made the whole process so easy. It’s rare these days to find a place you can trust 100%, but Coastal Car Fix is that place. Honest, fast, and reliable, I’ll trust them every time with my car. Truly the best in the business, local, dependable, and committed to their customers. I wouldn’t take my car anywhere else. Dan and his team have earned a lifelong customer, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking for quality auto care.

reviews.author: James Edge
reviews.text: Dan and the Car Fix team are the best! I asked them to do a tough job in removing and replacing the convertible top drive motor and cylinders on my 2002 Mustang Saleen. I couldn’t get anyone else to take this job. Dan said yes and 8 hours later my convertible top is operating like new. I knew what parts to order and was ready to supply them to whoever would do the labor; I don’t have the tools or skill for this one. Ford wouldn’t take the job, local convertible body works wouldn’t take the job. Coastal did the job. Marvelously. Highest recommendation! Jim Edge

reviews.author: Morgan
reviews.text: My original post was not a good review. I had an issue with my lug nuts not being tightened all the way and other pricing issues. However, after a beneficial conversation with Dan (owner), I have decided to change my review. I am still disappointed about my tires and oil but human make mistakes and Dan explained to me how they check brakes and my tires don’t have to be removed for that. Though my experience here wasn’t the greatest, I do appreciate the quick feedback and the support to make corrections for the future. I would ask for clarity for any shop prices going forward.

reviews.author: Janice Dello
reviews.text: I just want to thank Dan, the Owner, Jay, the Service Advisor and Chip, the Shuttle Driver for a wonderful experience I had with Coastal Car Fix. All 4 of my brakes and rotors needed replaced. From the time I walked in to the end of the service, I was treated with respect and would highly recommend them for all your vehicle needs!! Truly honest and very professional!! As a local, I will be back. Thank you again!

reviews.author: Jamie Knight
reviews.text: When I called to ask about scheduling service Dan assisted me. He was informative, very helpful and polite. They worked me in that day and my car was ready the next morning! Very efficient and quick. They kept me in the loop. Not once did I have to call them for updates! That was awesome! I would 100% recommend them!

reviews.author: rowdyrob3d
reviews.text: I'm not sure how their prices compare to the competition, but the customer service was excellent. I was scheduled for repair, and they kept me informed what problems they found, how much it would cost, and approximately how soon I could pick up my car. I have no complaints.

reviews.author: Cindi Morgan
reviews.text: I cannot say enough GREAT things about Coastal Car Fix!! Daniel and his crew are awesome!! We went in for an oil change, tire rotation, but after a thorough inspection, the found an oil gasket leak. Daniel called the warranty company to see if it was covered & it was!! Daniel got the part & installed it!! We are deeply pleased with the care we received at COASTAL CAR FIX!! If you’re looking for an honest, clean auto repair shop, this is the place to go!! You will not be disappointed!!!

reviews.author: Pete Williams
reviews.text: This shop should be the standard of how auto repair should work. Honest, quality work with friendly helpful personel. Plan to return as my go to shop. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Jared Collister
reviews.text: Finally a shop I feel like I can trust. These guys were amazing all the way through and through! Great customer care over the phone (which is hard to get in this area), when you walk in the building it’s as clean as it can possibly be, the guys in there are all great, they know what they’re doing, I had an issue with a self provided part they let me know right away worked with me on a time to come in when I got the proper part again, got it done quicker than anyone could’ve expected. Thank you to Jay (fantastic help), and not just myself he was great with all others who walked in looking for service. They offer a shuttle service to those who can’t stay in the shop and wait around, coffee, water, bathroom accommodations. This shop has it all, huge shout out and much more appreciation on top of that guys!

reviews.author: Jeff
reviews.text: I had an 8:30am appointment to fix a couple of issues with my 2017 Jeep Grand Cherokee and through my Car Max Maxcare they were able to take care of it in about 4 hours time with minimal charges. I highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Pj Welch
reviews.text: Very professional shop. They were quick to get my car in for service and I received it back the same day. Will use their service again.

reviews.author: John Middendorf
reviews.text: I have had a noise from under my car off and on for about a year. I brought it to the dealership who couldn’t hear the noise so I then brought it to Coastal Car Fix who diagnosed my problem and repaired it.

reviews.author: Sherri Canterbury
reviews.text: This was the best car repair experience I've had in my life ! I was on vacation scheduled to check out the following day when the battery indicator came on. I called Coastal Car Fix and they were able to get my car repaired that day and provide a shuttle service. They were so nice and really know how to care for their customers. I wish I lived closer, I'd use them for all my car repair needs.

reviews.author: Christie Funchess
reviews.text: These guys are top notch. Dan is great! If you are looking for a reliable mechanic this is your guy!!

reviews.author: Ronaka Davis
reviews.text: I had my car checked out because I thought there might be an issue. Dan and his crew went through everything thoroughly and couldn’t find a problem. What I really appreciated is that they didn’t try to take advantage of me or convince me there was something wrong. They were honest, straightforward, and very trustworthy. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Christopher Bell
reviews.text: I did not like how I received my truck after leaving this place. I was told that I needed an ABS wire upon leaving the shop however it was my hub bearing assembly. The truck was really unsafe to drive leaving their shop. The airline hoses For the four-wheel-drive to the hub were both ripped on either side. They saw that I had a warranty and tried to rack it up as much as they possibly could. I am very unhappy and would never take a vehicle back to this place or ever recommend this place to anybody.

reviews.author: Rémona Brooks
reviews.text: Dan, partner and tam were absolutely wonderful to us! We came down to Myrtle Beach for a few days and on the way down, the panel started flashing all kinds of warnings. I called Coastal Car Fix and left a message and Dan called me back. Once I explained what was happening, he allowed me to bring the car the same morning and offered transportation back to the hotel. He was able to tell me what was wrong with the vehicle, which I relayed to my mechanic. He didn't charge me a service fee and offered transport back to the shop to pick up my car! This is a business that has integrity and excellence. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for an honest and caring locally-owned business!

reviews.author: James “Dr. James” Cassillo
reviews.text: My wife brought her Audi 3 in for a check up because it was sluggish upon the acceleration. We weren’t sure what the problem was and the mechanics were very friendly and yes honest as it was only spark plugs. And a very reasonable repair price too! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: tresia
reviews.text: I called them first thing in the morning because I needed my car diagnosed. They saw me same day and had my car fixed in 2 hours-in time before I had to go to work. They even shuttled me home so I didn’t have to wait around there. Great service. They replaced my saay bar links and I now have zero clicking sound when I drive. Thank you!

reviews.author: DeeD
reviews.text: Everyone that i encountered were super nice, they explained to me what was wrong with my car and fixed it immediately for me! Would recommend

reviews.author: Samantha Desai
reviews.text: Had an awesome experience. Took great care of us & our vehicle. They were very communicative and i was able to text them with any questions and got very prompt responses. Jay was outstanding! Will definitely recommend this spot to everyone! Thank you guys for the amazing care you put into dealing with your customers!

reviews.author: Anita Perzan
reviews.text: Was looking for a locally owned car repair to use since my warranty has expired. The folks at Coastal Car Fix were quick to get me in for an oil change and I plan to use them for regular maintenance and repairs. They’re convenient and had a shuttle to take me home and bring me back while they worked on the vehicle.

reviews.author: Reto Zimmermann
reviews.text: The best auto repair experience of my life! (I am in my 60s) Professional, courteous with clear communications. Super fast. Thank you Dan. I will recommend your shop to anyone at anytime. Dan saved the weekend for this "stranded out-of-stater" Merci beaucoup!

reviews.author: The Davis’s
reviews.text: Magnificent service! We were there on vacation and our transmission went out the moment we arrived. We were in an unfamiliar place and had no clue what to do. We called all over and no one could help and it was a holiday. I called them and they immediately made us top priority. They handled everything and we didn’t have to lift a finger or keep calling for status updates because they were on top of it. They ordered and dropped in a new one and had us back on the road as scheduled. Best service I’ve ever received in my life. The communication was extraordinary as well. This was truly top tier service at an affordable price.

reviews.author: Sparkle Homes
reviews.text: Coastal Car Fix did a great job! I would definitely recommend them. My jeep had several problems w the brakes & they fixed all of the issues & also did an oil change. It was convenient for me because they were able to drop me off at home & pick me up later that afternoon when the work was finished. It was great to have my jeep done later that same day!

reviews.author: Rick
reviews.text: First time visitor. Dan, Chip and Steven were great to work with from front counter to repair completion. Highly recommend Coastal Car Fix. They will be my full time mechanic in the future.

reviews.author: Deborah Mcgraw
reviews.text: Everyone was awesome. Got me in quick service was great. Called with an issue and they got me in same day. Will return

reviews.author: Donna Lewis
reviews.text: I had a great experience with Coastal Car Fix. We were on vacation at Garden City and my steering gear systems went out. They were quick to find out what was wrong and worked with me to get it fixed. It was a very stressful situation for me and they assured me that everything would be fine and fixed in a timely manner. Thank you so much.

reviews.author: b woodruff
reviews.text: Took my 2008 ram 1500 there and very satisfied for my experience. My fixed my miss fire and did a overall check of my truck and realized my breaks where wearing abnormally. They quoted the job and did the repairs next day for an affordable price. I definitely recommend this shop and their staff.

reviews.author: Wayne Lomicky
reviews.text: Dan and Brett awesome…and started a unique new company. I brought my car in because I thought I needed a starter motor, but they did a free and thorough electronic car review and said the starter and alternator were fine, and all I needed was a battery. They put in a top battery one at a very reasonable cost. Gave a 36 month warranty which is crazy good. I highly recommend these guys, truly unique, and will refer friends. Thank you!

reviews.author: Betty Wood
reviews.text: We had a starter go out on our 2017 Tundra . Even though my husband was a master technician for Toyota it was too big of a job to handle on vacation. We called Coastal Car Fix and they were very professional even on the phone. They weren’t the first we called . Promised to have it ready the next day and they called us a little after lunch!!!! We were very pleased and satisfied with the service!!! Will recommend to others!!!

reviews.author: Kellie Mcinnis
reviews.text: My experience today was AMAZING on vacation & my Jeeps check engine light came on contacted a Jeep dealership was told they really didn't have an opening till Sept well not knowing any auto shops here I seen the reviews of Coastal Car Fix called not only did they get my jeep in 9AM the repair needed was complete in 2 hours THANK YOU if your a customer your treated like family blown away with the courtesy shuttle to my Condo & pickup also offered this is 5 star company with warranty & honest & AFFORDABLE service rare to see this in todays world .Thank You Coastal Car Fix !!! 5 STAR call this company for THE BEST SERVICE !!!

reviews.author: Mickey Bunts
reviews.text: Brought my car in for 2 module's that control the seat are.loose under the seat. Was told I had to get new seats since tabs broke off. No attempt was made to find a alternative way ro secure (zip ties maybe). Window regulator on driver's door needed to be replaced and Not made anymore. They were able to find a third party replacent and install. Not a huge fan of the 150 dollar diagnostic charge. Don't know if I'll return.

reviews.author: Michael Carfora
reviews.text: Called them same day to have a wheel bearing replaced. They accommodated me and got the job done in under 2 hours. These guys are too notch, customer service is on point and you can tell they genuinely care about their business. Highly recommend

reviews.author: Musings Affirmations
reviews.text: This place is honest and affordable. I’ve met the owner, and he’s the real deal. I recommend highly.

reviews.author: Nicholas Curcio
reviews.text: Coastal Car Fix was very friendly and helpful with making sure they could look into a possible brake issue with my truck while here for the weekend. They were very nice and transparent through my entire process. I would highly recommend them!!

reviews.author: Danny Epperson
reviews.text: Daniel and his staff are awesome!! Went in for routine maintenance and they found a small problem. Daniel called the warranty company, parts and labor was covered!! The part was ordered and properly installed! We have been looking for a reliable and HONEST auto repair shop and we finally found one!! I highly recommend Coastal Car Fix in Murrells Inlet!!!

reviews.author: Dan Dyer
reviews.text: Coastal Car Fix did an excellent job for me. They not only saved me money based on previous estimate else where, but he also alerted me to something others missed. Could have caused me major issues & money had they not found it. I would highly recommend Coastal Car Fix for all your car needs. Thanks Dan!

reviews.author: Mike Alcott
reviews.text: On vacation at Surfside Beach and seen my radiator leaking, cracked tank on my 06 H2. Looked them up and they said how much and just a few hours, they shuttled is back and came and picked me back up to get my H2!. And clean! Really impressed! Thank y'all

reviews.author: LAURA COX
reviews.text: The service was wonderful! One of the owners Chip is their shuttle driver so you're not stuck. They kept me informed of the progress of my car and it was a very responsible fix! I'm glad I found them!!

reviews.author: Mitch Combs
reviews.text: I can not express how much it means to find an honest business! In this world today where it feels like you can’t trust anyone….it was a breath of fresh air to meet Dan and his crew. He is honest almost to a fault. His shop is clean and modern. He uses the latest in technology for both diagnostics and customer interaction. Take your automobile to Dan. You will not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Brice Bier
reviews.text: I had an issue with Walmart in that they broke the oil drain plug off of my plastic oil pan on my 2023 Nissan Nissan rogue. The car was not drivable at that point so I had it towed to Coastal Car Fix. Dan got me in the very next day and replaced the oil pan a couple months later I had the car in at Nissan dealer and they told me that the oil pan was leaking. I took the car back to Coastal Car Fix because they had installed the new oil pan. Dan put the car up and they did a lot of looking around and they found that it was my timing cover gasket that was leaking and not the oil pan. Dan wrote up a real nice report and included a picture of the problem and I took that report back to the Nissan dealer and as of right now, Nissan has agreed to replace the gasket under warranty Dan didn’t charge me anything for the time he spent finding the problem I highly recommend this place ! Very professional and very courteous! Hard to find these days. Definitely two thumbs up

reviews.author: Pete Pescheff
reviews.text: My experience with Costal Car Fix was a good one. Brought the car in for a no start problem and some routine maintenance. They discovered a serious oil loss issue and repaired it, lucky for me. Five Stars for you, thank you much.

reviews.author: Allison Wikle
reviews.text: I had the honor of being their first customer. 100% happy with the service, communication and pricing. I used to go to the dealership but I now have a new and better place to get work done. They told me how everything under the hood looked and made me feel secure with my girl!

reviews.author: Kaylee Bandy
reviews.text: Dan and his team are second to none in the Grand Strand. We travel all the way from Florence to have our vehicles serviced by his team. This shop is exceptional with premier customer service, pricing, and expertise. You will not regret taking relying on Coastal Car Fix for all of your automotive needs.

reviews.author: Zachary Morris
reviews.text: My wife took her car in there for an oil change and 100k miles service. Dan and team made her feel welcome, inspected the vehicle, and gave us peace of mind that the car was in good condition and was safe to drive hopefully for another 100k Thanks Coastal Car Fix.

reviews.author: Kevin Mourato
reviews.text: Awesome people and very clean shop. They repaid my vehicle fast and had me back on the road same day.

reviews.author: Jimmy Evans
reviews.text: I was referred to Coastal Car Fix by a friend and had an oil change, lube and filter done. Dan, the owner, was more that polite and professional. As a walk in, my car was done in 20 minutes. Shop was immaculate and clean. My new go-to auto mechanic!

reviews.author: Chantz Roberts
reviews.text: Came down on a road trip to Myrtle for a fun weekend getaway. Needed an oil change before I hit the road back. Stumbled upon this shop and was it a great experience. Transparent service, quick turnaround time, super clean lobby area, extremely friendly service. Couldn’t have picked a better shop to trust my maverick with.

reviews.author: Kat P
reviews.text: Dan and his staff listened to all my concerns! After 3 - 4 years and $8,000 in repairs from 'BIG CORPORATE' mechanic shops lying to me, up charging me, over charging me (I was told by one they have weekend rates which are double regular weekly rates) and basically scaring me into thousands of dollars of repairs that weren't necessary because Im a single woman, Dan and his staff explained every thing in detail and showed me all the parts that needed changing, which was not found previously. Very transparent with everything they did. They even brought me to work. I have found my local, honest, reliable mechanic and being Veteran-Owned is definitely a plus for me!!! Thank you, Thank you, Thank you!!!!

reviews.author: Ron Van
reviews.text: I received great service from Coastal Car, from the mechanic to customer service. Dan (mgr) even had the mechanic stay late so my car would be ready the same day. I highly recommend Coastal for any of your car repairs.

reviews.author: Nicholas Swan
reviews.text: Great mechanics, great service. The team took care of my car did a thorough job. Dan communicated well through the process and I'm very happy with the results!

reviews.author: Dustin Savitsky
reviews.text: Great mechanic shop! They do a quality vehicle inspection and I was very satisfied with the work they did on my old van. I have recommended their shop to many friends.

reviews.author: Pamela C Livingston

reviews.author: Audrey Shaw
